interpretation: train-scene exploratory zero-shot alignment; no policy or navigation result

rules.whole: last-two-frame mean cosine with full fixed-64-token instruction
rules.final_clause: last-two-frame mean cosine with final clause
rules.last_two_clauses: last-two-frame mean cosine with mean final-two clauses
rules.ordered_path: max-sum monotone frame-to-clause path from first to last clause, divided by six
rules.ordered_path_gain: ordered path score minus repeated-initial-frame path score
